title: Chronosense Read-Write Middleware and Citation Auditor
hypothesis: A zero-retraining, <1 ms/turn read-write Chronosense middleware backed by sceneGeometry and canonicalChart digest auditing reduces long-horizon temporal confusion, redundant tool loops, and missed deadlines in live LLM agents relative to passive ISO timestamps and synthetic 24h clocks.
null_baseline: Passive ISO-8601 UTC prompt injection (Control-ISO) and read-write elapsed-seconds + sin/cos(2*pi*t/86400) cursor (Control-Synthetic).
success_bar: Hard promotion gate: (1) EXP-001 deterministic harness passes with <1 ms/turn compute and 100% cursor-drift detection, AND (2) EXP-005 live-LLM eval shows >=20% error reduction vs Control-ISO and statistically meaningful margin over Control-Synthetic on cross-latitude/compaction/deadline episodes.
kill_criterion: If EXP-005 live-LLM eval shows Control-Synthetic ties Treatment-Caelus-Physical across all episode slices (including high-latitude photoperiod and cross-compaction), cancel FACT-002 and archive the middleware rationale to lab/graveyard/.
